caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a piece of metal hardware, possibly a tool or fastener. The object has a brown, rusted appearance and is composed of a long, flat, slightly curved bar with a square hole near its upper center. At the top of the object, the bar bends outward into two symmetrical, curved hooks pointing in opposite directions, resembling a horizontal letter "T". Near the bottom of the bar, there is a three-dimensional, geometric shape attached, which resembles a faceted bolt or knob. The background is an unmarked, off-white or beige color, and there are no other objects or designs present. The artist's name, Daniel J. Grant, is written in small text near the lower right corner.
title: Iron Pot Hook
